items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. Well, I recorded with... He was on the same record I was on with Wilton Crawley(?)

ctx.x: some of that old stuff. You know what ones I've been listenin' to lately? The ones on Wilton Crawley(?). I said, 'Man, he's not too bad for what he was doing.'
Well, didn't you write your own composition, 'Poor Little Me' at about this time?
